LanguageData.LP_Bs_DockChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on the Waterdeep docks, hauling cargo for merchant ships by day and listening to sailors' tall tales by night. [PAWN_nameDef] learned to sweet-talk drunks, and to strike first when sweet talk failed.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DockChild.title: Waterdeep dock kid
LanguageData.LP_Bs_GateUrchin.description: No child of Baldur's Gate's lower city grows up empty-handed. [PAWN_nameDef] can pick locks, run, and put on an innocent face in front of Flaming Fist patrols.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_GateUrchin.title: Baldur's Gate street urchin
LanguageData.LP_Bs_SwordCoastFarm.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is the child of a small farming family on the Sword Coast: growing turnips, herding sheep, dodging goblins. Every autumn adventurers passed through the village, and [PAWN_nameDef] always stared after them.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_SwordCoastFarm.title: Sword Coast farm child
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CandlekeepScribe.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the scriptorium of Candlekeep, copying old book after old book for the monks. [PAWN_nameDef] has read more forbidden books than most wizards; nobody knows.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CandlekeepScribe.title: Candlekeep scribe child
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HarperWard.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s parents died in an assassination linked to Thay. The Harpers took [PAWN_nameDef] in and taught [PAWN_objective] codes, archery, and "never trust anyone in red robes".
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HarperWard.title: Harper foster child
LanguageData.LP_Bs_TavernHand.description: [PAWN_nameDef] washed dishes and served stew in a tavern called the Yawning Portal. [PAWN_nameDef] was the first to hear every wanted poster and every treasure map rumor.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_TavernHand.title: adventurers' tavern helper
LanguageData.LP_Bs_TempleOrphan.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was abandoned on the steps of the Morninglord's temple and raised by the priests. The first thing [PAWN_nameDef] learned was bandaging wounds, the second was praying at sunrise.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_TempleOrphan.title: dawn temple orphan
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CaravanChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born on a caravan wagon, traveling from Amn to Calimshan and back again. [PAWN_nameDef] remembers which wells have water and which checkpoints need a bribe on every trade road.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CaravanChild.title: caravan born
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Adventurer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has taken every kind of commission on the board: clearing goblin nests, escorting caravans, finding lost cats. Most teammates died along the way; [PAWN_nameDef] survived, and feels a little guilty about it.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Adventurer.title: bounty adventurer
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DungeonDelver.description: [PAWN_nameDef] specializes in tombs and dungeons nobody else dares enter. [PAWN_nameDef] can smell a trap, and knows the most valuable thing in a chest is often the unremarkable map.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DungeonDelver.title: dungeon delver
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Bard.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has sung in every tavern on the Sword Coast and owes money to every one of them. [PAWN_nameDef]'s songs can make enemies lay down their weapons, and friends draw theirs.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Bard.title: wandering bard
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RangerGuide.description: [PAWN_nameDef] guided caravans through the wilds and kept watch on the edge of the High Forest for many years. [PAWN_nameDef] would rather sleep under the stars than spend one more night in a city.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RangerGuide.title: frontier ranger
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CityWatch.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served in the Waterdeep City Watch for years, catching thieves, stopping drunks, and one rainy night seeing a beholder float out of the sewers.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CityWatch.title: city watch sergeant
LanguageData.LP_Bs_FailedWizard.description: [PAWN_nameDef] studied at a wizard academy for seven years and was expelled after an experiment blew up half a tower. [PAWN_nameDef] insists that experiment was "a success in theory".
LanguageData.LP_Bs_FailedWizard.title: failed wizard
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ThievesGuild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a member of the Shadow Thieves, collecting protection money, picking locks, and occasionally "persuading" merchants who wouldn't pay. There are only two ways to leave the guild, and [PAWN_nameDef] chose the rarer one.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ThievesGuild.title: thieves' guild member
LanguageData.LP_Bs_FlamingFist.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served in the Flaming Fist mercenary company of Baldur's Gate, fighting goblins, pirates and cultists. The company's creed is simple: take the money first, then draw the sword.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_FlamingFist.title: Flaming Fist mercenary
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Homesteader.description: [PAWN_nameDef] followed Faerûn's pioneer league to several ownerless lands, felling trees, building walls and clearing fields. [PAWN_nameDef] built three villages by hand and watched two of them burn.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Homesteader.title: pioneer settler
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Alchemist.description: [PAWN_nameDef] sold potions at the market: healing potions, invisibility potions, and potions said to regrow hair. The first two were mostly real.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Alchemist.title: street alchemist
LanguageData.LP_Bs_TempleChoir.description: [PAWN_nameDef] sang hymns in a temple choir from childhood. [PAWN_nameDef]'s voice was so good that even the grumpiest old priest would close his eyes to listen.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_TempleChoir.title: temple choir child
LanguageData.LP_Bs_MorninglordAcolyte.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is an acolyte of Lathander, Morninglord, running between plague villages and battlefields. [PAWN_nameDef] believes every dawn is a new chance, even for the worst people.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_MorninglordAcolyte.title: acolyte of the dawn church
LanguageData.LP_Bs_TyrPaladin.description: [PAWN_nameDef] swore an oath to Tyr, god of justice, to protect the weak and judge the guilty. Scales are engraved on [PAWN_nameDef]'s shield, and every word of the oath on the sword.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_TyrPaladin.title: paladin of Tyr
LanguageData.LP_Bs_KelemvorUndertaker.description: [PAWN_nameDef] serves Kelemvor, god of death, burying nameless corpses and guiding lost souls. [PAWN_nameDef] hates all undead, liches most of all.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_KelemvorUndertaker.title: undertaker of Kelemvor
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Pilgrim.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has visited every holy site in Faerûn, leaving a copper coin at each shrine. [PAWN_nameDef] says [PAWN_pronoun] is looking for an answer, but never says what the question is.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Pilgrim.title: wandering pilgrim
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ThayBorn.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in a slave camp on the Thayan plateau and has carried stones in the quarry for as long as [PAWN_pronoun] can remember. Red Wizards walking past [PAWN_nameDef] never looked down even once.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ThayBorn.title: child of a Thayan slave camp
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RedRobeApprentice.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was sent to a Thayan spell school as a child. There, poisoning classmates is an elective and betrayal is required.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RedRobeApprentice.title: Red Wizard apprentice
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RedWizard.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a Red Wizard of Thay, head shaved and covered in spell tattoos. In Thay the Red Wizards are masters of everything; outside Thay, [PAWN_nameDef] still thinks so.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RedWizard.title: Red Wizard of Thay
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RuneTamer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] branded sigils onto the trolls of the Thayan army. Every scar on [PAWN_nameDef]'s arms came from a troll not yet broken.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RuneTamer.title: sigil beastmaster
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ThayConscript.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was conscripted by Thay and stood at the very front of the skeleton and troll ranks. Nobody taught [PAWN_nameDef] to read, only how not to look back during a charge.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ThayConscript.title: Thayan slave soldier
LanguageData.LP_Bs_NecroForeman.description: [PAWN_nameDef] oversaw the stitching and raising of corpses in a Thayan necromancy workshop. [PAWN_nameDef] has far more patience with the dead than the living.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_NecroForeman.title: necromancy workshop overseer
LanguageData.LP_Bs_TaxCollector.description: [PAWN_nameDef] collected taxes for a Thayan governor. Peasants who couldn't pay had two choices: hand over a son, or hand over themselves. [PAWN_nameDef] would politely ask which.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_TaxCollector.title: Thayan tax collector
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ForgeSlaveChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up beside a fire giant's furnace, pulling bellows ropes and passing tongs to the anvil. [PAWN_nameDef]'s arms are covered in little scars from flying sparks.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ForgeSlaveChild.title: furnace slave child
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ForgeThrall.description: [PAWN_nameDef] forged iron for the fire giants of the ember clan for many years. Fire giants never remember a slave's name, but they remember that [PAWN_nameDef]'s swords never chip.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ForgeThrall.title: forge slave laborer
LanguageData.LP_Bs_SlagOverseer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] managed a gang of slave laborers for the fire giants, whip in hand, with a master twice [PAWN_possessive] height standing behind. [PAWN_nameDef] knows full well [PAWN_pronoun] is a slave too, just in slightly better shackles.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_SlagOverseer.title: slag overseer
LanguageData.LP_Bs_UnderdarkFoundling.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the tunnels of the Underdark and never saw the sun. [PAWN_nameDef] can find the way in total darkness, and learned to hide the moment wet footsteps are heard.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_UnderdarkFoundling.title: Underdark foundling
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Thrall.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was dominated by mind flayers for many years, digging tunnels and hauling corpses for the colony. Those years are a grey fog; sometimes a face surfaces, but never whose it was.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Thrall.title: colony thrall
LanguageData.LP_Bs_PoolKeeper.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s job was tending the elder brain's brine pool: adjusting the salt, clearing the residue, putting fresh brains in. [PAWN_nameDef] still hears whispers from the pool in dreams.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_PoolKeeper.title: brine pool keeper
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Smuggler.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran tadpole jars for the Black Network, smuggled dragon eggs, and carried letters for both Thay and the Harpers at once. [PAWN_nameDef]'s only rule: never ask where the goods came from, never ask where the client is going.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Smuggler.title: Black Network smuggler
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Fence.description: [PAWN_nameDef] can tell at a glance whether a magic item is real or fake, stolen or robbed. The first decides the price; the second decides the discount.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Fence.title: stolen goods appraiser
LanguageData.LP_Bs_WitchHunter.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has hunted sorcerers, druids, liches, and many old women who merely knew their herbs. Every "witch"'s name is engraved on [PAWN_nameDef]'s silver crossbow bolts.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_WitchHunter.title: witch hunter
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Bookburner.description: [PAWN_nameDef] believes magic is the root of all suffering and has burned the libraries of three wizard towers. [PAWN_nameDef] preaches with great charisma, especially standing next to a bonfire.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Bookburner.title: book-burning friar
LanguageData.LP_Bs_UndyingArchmage.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an archmage in life and had no intention of stopping research after death. [PAWN_nameDef] no longer remembers what a heartbeat sounds like.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_UndyingArchmage.title: undying archmage
LanguageData.LP_Bs_PhylacteryHermit.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hid [PAWN_possessive] phylactery where only [PAWN_pronoun] knows, then spent three hundred years alone in a tower. [PAWN_nameDef] dislikes visitors, especially visitors carrying holy symbols.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_PhylacteryHermit.title: phylactery secret-keeper
LanguageData.LP_Bs_FosterGiant.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was found and raised by a human farming family. By ten [PAWN_nameDef] was taller than the barn, and the villagers never needed a ladder to fix a roof again.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_FosterGiant.title: giant child raised by humans
LanguageData.LP_Bs_GiantWanderer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] migrated between ridges with a giant wandering band, following the seasons and the game. [PAWN_nameDef] has seen more horizons than any human.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_GiantWanderer.title: wanderer of a giant band
LanguageData.LP_Bs_LavaHallChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the lava halls deep in a volcano and could swing at five a hammer human smiths cannot lift. [PAWN_nameDef]'s cradle was a cooled crucible.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_LavaHallChild.title: hammer child of the lava halls
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HostageChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was sent as a hostage to a rival clan as a child and grew up beside someone else's forge. [PAWN_nameDef] learned to read faces, and to hide hatred behind a smile.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HostageChild.title: ember clan hostage
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ForgeSmith.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the clan's best smiths; the weapons [PAWN_pronoun] forges can split city gates. To [PAWN_nameDef], there are only two kinds of things in the world: those that can be melted and those not yet melted.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ForgeSmith.title: forge clan smith
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Warband.description: [PAWN_nameDef] led a squad of slave soldiers and giants to punish villages that refused tribute for the clan. [PAWN_nameDef] believes strength is order, and order is hammered out.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Warband.title: fire giant warband chief
LanguageData.LP_Bs_SurtrKeeper.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tends the clan's sacred fire and offers the finest forgings to Surtur, god of the giants. [PAWN_nameDef] says the future can be seen in the flames, and the future is always burning.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_SurtrKeeper.title: fire-keeper of Surtur
LanguageData.LP_Bs_WolfPlaymate.description: As a child [PAWN_nameDef] slept on the same bearskin as a litter of winter wolf pups. Grown up, those wolves still obey only [PAWN_nameDef].
LanguageData.LP_Bs_WolfPlaymate.title: playmate of winter wolf pups
LanguageData.LP_Bs_WolfMaster.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is the tribe's winter wolf master and can tell every wolf apart by its howl in a blizzard. On the ice fields, [PAWN_nameDef]'s pack is more reliable than any city wall.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_WolfMaster.title: winter wolf master
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Reaver.description: [PAWN_nameDef] sailed ice ships south along the coast, raiding for grain, iron and slaves. [PAWN_nameDef] thinks winter is the gods' gift to frost giants, and southerners are the wrapping paper.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Reaver.title: ice field reaver
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CastleHeir.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a castle floating among the clouds, with mist below and stars above. As a child [PAWN_nameDef] thought the humans on the ground were moving toys.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CastleHeir.title: cloud castle noble child
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Envoy.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as envoy of the cloud court to the human kingdoms: giving gifts, negotiating, noting every slight. [PAWN_nameDef]'s gifts are always too precious, so precious the other side can never repay them.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Envoy.title: cloud court envoy
LanguageData.LP_Bs_WeatherSeer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] can read the language of wind and clouds, foretelling harvests and storms for the court. Human farmers would trade a whole year's harvest for one word from [PAWN_nameDef].
LanguageData.LP_Bs_WeatherSeer.title: weather mage
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DeepPalace.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a coral palace on the seabed, swimming with whales and learning the rhythm of prophecy from the tides.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DeepPalace.title: child of the deep sea palace
LanguageData.LP_Bs_StormOracle.description: [PAWN_nameDef] meditates in storms and reads the gods' intentions in the thunder. [PAWN_nameDef]'s prophecies always come true; it's just that nobody ever understands them before they do.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_StormOracle.title: storm prophet
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DeepExile.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was exiled from the deep sea court over a prophecy [PAWN_pronoun] refused to speak aloud. Since then, [PAWN_nameDef] looks up at every thunderstorm, as if waiting for someone to call [PAWN_objective] home.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DeepExile.title: deep sea exile
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DivineFoundling.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s father was a god and mother a mortal, and neither side came to take [PAWN_nameDef] home. When [PAWN_nameDef] threw a tantrum at age five, hail fell over the village.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DivineFoundling.title: godborn foundling
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HeroDisciple.description: [PAWN_nameDef] wanders Faerûn slaying monsters for the weak, trying to prove [PAWN_pronoun] is worthy of that half of divine blood. Poets have already written several songs about [PAWN_nameDef], most of them made up.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HeroDisciple.title: disciple of a demigod
LanguageData.LP_Bs_PeakWatcher.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept watch on a nameless mountaintop for decades, not knowing what [PAWN_pronoun] was waiting for. Perhaps an omen, perhaps a word from [PAWN_possessive] father.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_PeakWatcher.title: summit watcher
LanguageData.LP_Bs_BogWhelp.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a swamp, ate anything, and bit siblings when still hungry. Bitten-off arms grow back in a few days anyway, so nobody minded much.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_BogWhelp.title: hungry swamp whelp
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RuneboundWhelp.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was caught very young by Thayan beastmasters and had a sigil branded on [PAWN_possessive] back. [PAWN_nameDef] still remembers the burning pain, just not the face of the one who branded it.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RuneboundWhelp.title: branded troll whelp
LanguageData.LP_Bs_BridgeToll.description: [PAWN_nameDef] lived under a stone bridge for many years, charging every passerby a toll. Those who couldn't pay left a leg behind. [PAWN_nameDef]'s own legs grow back anyway, so it never seemed excessive.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_BridgeToll.title: toll troll under the bridge
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RuneboundTroll.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a sigil troll in the Thayan army, driven to the front by spells. When the master died, the voice of the sigil finally went quiet, and for the first time [PAWN_nameDef] realized [PAWN_pronoun] was hungry.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RuneboundTroll.title: Thayan sigil troll
LanguageData.LP_Bs_AshHunter.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was the best hunter of a troll tribe in the ashes, able to chase a deer for three days and nights. The deer usually gave up on the second day.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_AshHunter.title: ash tribe hunter
LanguageData.LP_Bs_TribeHalfblood.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in an orc tribe and was always beaten for impure blood. [PAWN_nameDef] quickly learned to beat others before getting beaten.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_TribeHalfblood.title: half-blood whelp of an orc tribe
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CityStreetHalfOrc.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was the only child in town with tusks. Neighbors locked their doors, merchants charged more, and the town guard questioned [PAWN_objective] on sight. [PAWN_nameDef] learned patience, and learned to keep score.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CityStreetHalfOrc.title: scorned town child
LanguageData.LP_Bs_PitFighter.description: [PAWN_nameDef] won forty fights in a row in the underground arenas of Calimshan. The crowd chanted [PAWN_nameDef]'s name, gamblers got rich on [PAWN_objective], and [PAWN_nameDef] got only freedom.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_PitFighter.title: arena champion
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ChainBreaker.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was once chained in Thay's slave soldier ranks, then smashed the chains with comrades and escaped. The marks of the shackles remain on [PAWN_nameDef]'s wrists, and [PAWN_nameDef] has no intention of removing them.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ChainBreaker.title: brokenchain warband deserter
LanguageData.LP_Bs_GruumshPriest.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was once a priest of Gruumsh in an orc tribe, presiding over blood sacrifices before battle. [PAWN_nameDef] later left the tribe but still keeps the habit of praying before every fight.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_GruumshPriest.title: priest of the one-eyed god
LanguageData.LP_Bs_MoonwoodChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a moonlit old forest, singing with dryads and drinking with unicorns. By elven standards [PAWN_nameDef]'s childhood was a brief single century.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_MoonwoodChild.title: child of the moonlit woods
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ScoutChild.description: At fifty [PAWN_nameDef] was still a child, yet could already run silently through the treetops and hit a squirrel's tail from a hundred paces.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ScoutChild.title: woodland scout apprentice
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CenturySinger.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent a hundred years learning one song, and another hundred learning to sing it well. Humans weep when [PAWN_nameDef] sings, without knowing why.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CenturySinger.title: century singer
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Warden.description: [PAWN_nameDef] guards the borders of the elven forest and has driven off loggers, goblins and an entire orc warband with arrows. [PAWN_nameDef] remembers every tree that was cut down.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Warden.title: forest guard
LanguageData.LP_Bs_EvermeetExile.description: [PAWN_nameDef] comes from a noble house of Evermeet and was exiled to the mainland over a scandal [PAWN_pronoun] refuses to explain. [PAWN_nameDef] is disappointed in human cities, and even more in human lifespans.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_EvermeetExile.title: exiled noble of Evermeet
LanguageData.LP_Bs_MineChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the mine tunnels of Mithral Hall, falling asleep to the sound of picks. The first time [PAWN_nameDef] saw the sky, [PAWN_pronoun] asked what ore that blue stone was.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_MineChild.title: raised in the mines
LanguageData.LP_Bs_BreweryChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] helped in the family wine cellar from childhood: carrying barrels, rolling barrels, secretly tasting barrels. Dwarves say it's the best education there is.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_BreweryChild.title: cellar child laborer
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RuneSmith.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is the seventeenth generation of smiths in the family, with hands steadier than an engraver's when carving runes on the anvil. [PAWN_nameDef] never sells to elves, though they always bid highest.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RuneSmith.title: rune smith
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ShieldDwarf.description: [PAWN_nameDef] stood guard at the gates of a dwarven fortress for thirty years. [PAWN_nameDef]'s shield bears a deep claw mark left by a rock dragon; the dragon is gone, the shield remains.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ShieldDwarf.title: shield dwarf guard
LanguageData.LP_Bs_GrudgeKeeper.description: [PAWN_nameDef] keeps the family's book of blood debts: who owes whom, how much, and when it will be repaid. Dozens of names in the book are not yet crossed out, and [PAWN_nameDef] has forgotten none of them.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_GrudgeKeeper.title: blood debt collector
LanguageData.LP_Bs_SpawnPool.description: [PAWN_nameDef] had no childhood. [PAWN_nameDef]'s mind woke up in a human body already knowing who [PAWN_pronoun] was, whom to obey, and what brains taste like.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_SpawnPool.title: colony spawning pool
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ElderVoice.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was the voice of an elder brain, relaying the master brain's will to every member of the colony. That vast voice still echoes in [PAWN_nameDef]'s head.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ElderVoice.title: elder brain herald
LanguageData.LP_Bs_PsionicHunter.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hunted fresh brains for the colony. [PAWN_nameDef] prefers clever prey: they taste better and are more fun when they run.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_PsionicHunter.title: psionic hunter
LanguageData.LP_Bs_IllithidRenegade.description: One day [PAWN_nameDef] could no longer hear the elder brain's voice. Without the master brain, [PAWN_nameDef] began to think for the first time about what [PAWN_pronoun] wanted, and the answer frightened even [PAWN_objective].
LanguageData.LP_Bs_IllithidRenegade.title: colony defector
LanguageData.LP_Bs_MazeChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in an ancient labyrinth and can find the exit with eyes closed. [PAWN_nameDef]'s favorite childhood game was getting intruding humans lost.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_MazeChild.title: raised in a labyrinth
LanguageData.LP_Bs_BaphometCharger.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a shock trooper in the army of the demon lord Baphomet, battering down gates and shield walls with horns. Since escaping, [PAWN_nameDef] refuses to lower that head, except to charge.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_BaphometCharger.title: Baphomet's shock trooper
LanguageData.LP_Bs_MazeArchitect.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has designed several labyrinths, each harder to escape than the last. [PAWN_nameDef] says a good labyrinth is like a good home: outsiders can't get in, family can get out.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_MazeArchitect.title: labyrinth architect
LanguageData.LP_Bs_AstralCreche.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a secret crèche on the Material Plane, where children must kill a mind flayer before adulthood or they are not githyanki. [PAWN_nameDef] passed the test.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_AstralCreche.title: astral crèche
LanguageData.LP_Bs_SilverKnight.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a knight of the lich-queen Vlaakith and was granted a silver sword. [PAWN_nameDef] has cut off the heads of a dozen mind flayers with it, each one offered to the queen.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_SilverKnight.title: silver sword knight
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DragonRider.description: [PAWN_nameDef] patrols the Astral Sea on a red dragon bound by an ancient pact with the githyanki. The dragon has never liked [PAWN_nameDef], but has never let [PAWN_objective] fall.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DragonRider.title: red dragon rider
LanguageData.LP_Bs_AstralRaider.description: [PAWN_nameDef] raided countless worlds aboard an astral ship. To the githyanki, plunder is not a crime but a craft.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_AstralRaider.title: astral pirate
LanguageData.LP_Bs_EmberHands.description: Whenever [PAWN_nameDef] got angry, [PAWN_possessive] hair caught fire, burning the curtains at home several times. Later [PAWN_nameDef] learned to go be angry in the kitchen, where fire is needed anyway.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_EmberHands.title: scorching hearth child
LanguageData.LP_Bs_TideChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a seaside fishing village and can hold [PAWN_possessive] breath underwater all day. The fishermen say no boat ever capsizes as long as [PAWN_nameDef] stands at the bow.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_TideChild.title: fishing village tide child
LanguageData.LP_Bs_StoneVein.description: [PAWN_nameDef] played in the quarry as a child and could feel ore veins barefoot. The masons gave [PAWN_objective] a nickname: the walking divining rod.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_StoneVein.title: quarry vein child
LanguageData.LP_Bs_KiteChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up atop a windmill tower and never had to wait for wind to fly a kite. [PAWN_nameDef] says the wind talks to [PAWN_objective]; the grown-ups took it as a joke.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_KiteChild.title: kite-flying child of the windmill
LanguageData.LP_Bs_PlaneVisitor.description: [PAWN_nameDef] once went through a portal and lived for a few years on the elemental plane of [PAWN_possessive] bloodline. After coming back, everything on the Material Plane felt too mild and too quiet.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_PlaneVisitor.title: elemental plane visitor
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CalimshanGuard.description: [PAWN_nameDef] guarded wealthy merchants in Calimshan, where genasi are common and valuable. [PAWN_nameDef]'s employer liked to show [PAWN_objective] off to guests like a rare treasure.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CalimshanGuard.title: Calimshan guild guard
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ElementalAttuner.description: [PAWN_nameDef] can sense the elemental power sleeping in objects and tunes magic weapons for wizards and smiths. [PAWN_nameDef] says every sword has its own temper.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ElementalAttuner.title: elemental tuner
LanguageData.LP_Bs_LoxodonScribe.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a loxodon sanctuary, copying scripture with a pen held in [PAWN_possessive] trunk. [PAWN_nameDef] remembers every page, because loxodons never forget.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_LoxodonScribe.title: sanctuary scribe child
LanguageData.LP_Bs_StoneMonk.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a stonemason monk who has spent forty years carving the gates of a temple. Every cut is a prayer, and [PAWN_nameDef] is not done yet.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_StoneMonk.title: stonemason monk
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Peacekeeper.description: [PAWN_nameDef] settles disputes and protects the weak in the city. [PAWN_nameDef] rarely raises a hand, but when [PAWN_pronoun] does, things turn peaceful right away.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Peacekeeper.title: peacekeeper
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CaveBrute.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a cave with only one rule: whoever has the biggest fists eats first. [PAWN_nameDef] was always the one who ate first.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CaveBrute.title: big lug from the cave
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HiredMuscle.description: [PAWN_nameDef] works as muscle for whoever pays most: Thay, the Black Network, bandits, anyone. [PAWN_nameDef]'s only demand is meals included, and plenty of them.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HiredMuscle.title: hired muscle
LanguageData.LP_Bs_GlutCook.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was the cook at a roadside inn, making stews big enough to feed a whole squad. [PAWN_nameDef] never reads recipes, only how much is left in the pot.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_GlutCook.title: big-appetite cook
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CliffNest.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a cliffside nest and learned to fly before learning to walk. To this day [PAWN_nameDef] cannot understand why anyone would want to live underground.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_CliffNest.title: raised in a high cliff nest
LanguageData.LP_Bs_WindMessenger.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carries letters for the cities at the mountain's foot and can fly over three kingdoms in a day. [PAWN_nameDef] has seen too many secrets and learned not to read the letters.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_WindMessenger.title: wind messenger
LanguageData.LP_Bs_SkyPatrol.description: [PAWN_nameDef] patrols the tribe's skies, driving off griffons and wyverns with javelins. [PAWN_nameDef] can hit a rabbit on the ground in mid-dive.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_SkyPatrol.title: sky patroller
LanguageData.LP_Bs_BrassPage.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a page in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire, serving the sultan fire wine. Since then [PAWN_nameDef] has known the best gift is the one delivered before the other person asks.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_BrassPage.title: court page of the City of Brass
LanguageData.LP_Bs_LampBound.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was sealed in a lamp by a wizard and spent a full thousand years in darkness. [PAWN_nameDef] granted many masters' wishes; every one came true, just not always the way the master wanted.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_LampBound.title: genie trapped for a thousand years
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Vizier.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was once grand vizier of an elemental court, running the affairs of an entire city for the sultan. [PAWN_nameDef] is tolerant of mortal manners but disappointed by mortal ledgers.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_Vizier.title: grand vizier of an elemental court
LanguageData.LP_Bs_AbyssSpawn.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born amid the Blood War of the Abyss, and the first thing learned was to hold six blades at once. In the Abyss, children who can't learn don't survive the first day.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_AbyssSpawn.title: spawn of the abyssal battlefield
LanguageData.LP_Bs_AbyssGeneral.description: [PAWN_nameDef] once commanded an entire demon legion in the Blood War of the Abyss. Each of [PAWN_nameDef]'s six hands holds a sword, and each has its own name and story.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_AbyssGeneral.title: abyssal general
LanguageData.LP_Bs_BoundServant.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was bound by a Thayan summoner's pact for decades. When the summoner died the pact lapsed, and for the first time [PAWN_nameDef] could choose where to go.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_BoundServant.title: pact-bound
LanguageData.LP_Bs_SplitBorn.description: [PAWN_nameDef] split off from a parent and was born with some hazy memories. [PAWN_nameDef] often can't tell which memories are [PAWN_possessive] own and which belong to the parent.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_SplitBorn.title: born of fission
LanguageData.LP_Bs_SpelljammerHand.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a sailor on an astral freighter for many years and could squeeze into pipes to repair the ship. When the ship crashed on this world, [PAWN_nameDef] was the only one who broke no bones, because [PAWN_nameDef] has no bones at all.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_SpelljammerHand.title: astral freighter sailor
LanguageData.LP_Bs_SewerKeeper.description: [PAWN_nameDef] works in the sewers of Waterdeep, clearing silt, driving off rats and dealing with things that shouldn't be in a sewer. [PAWN_nameDef] says it's quite comfortable down there, damp and dark.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_SewerKeeper.title: sewer warden
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HornedOutcast.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born different, and the villagers said it was the mark of a god or a devil. Whichever it was, they did not want [PAWN_nameDef] to stay.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HornedOutcast.title: child driven out of the village
LanguageData.LP_Bs_AasimarPenitent.description: A celestial guide always speaks in [PAWN_nameDef]'s dreams, but the voice grows ever more distant. [PAWN_nameDef] wanders Faerûn healing people, trying to find that voice again.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_AasimarPenitent.title: penitent of celestial blood
LanguageData.LP_Bs_FallenPaladin.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was once a paladin who broke [PAWN_possessive] oath after a battle that could not be undone. The sword remains; the faith was lost who knows where.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_FallenPaladin.title: fallen paladin
LanguageData.LP_Bs_InfernalLawyer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] reviews contracts mortals sign with devils and finds every trap in them. Business is always good, because mortals always sign first and come to [PAWN_nameDef] afterwards.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_InfernalLawyer.title: infernal contract lawyer
LanguageData.LP_Bs_TieflingGrifter.description: [PAWN_nameDef] realized that since people would think anyone with horns is a con artist anyway, [PAWN_pronoun] might as well actually be one. [PAWN_nameDef] is excellent at it.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_TieflingGrifter.title: street swindler
LanguageData.LP_Bs_PurpleDragonKnight.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was once a Purple Dragon knight of Cormyr, charging under the king's banner. When the war ended, [PAWN_nameDef]'s company was down to three people and a scorched flag.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_PurpleDragonKnight.title: Purple Dragon knight
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DragonSlayer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has killed only one dragon in [PAWN_possessive] life, at the cost of half the party and one ear. To this day any sound like beating wings wakes [PAWN_objective].
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DragonSlayer.title: dragonslayer
LanguageData.LP_Bs_MonsterHunter.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hunts monsters for bounties: owlbears, manticores, harpies that snatch children at night. [PAWN_nameDef]'s pack always holds silver dust, salt and a heavily annotated bestiary.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_MonsterHunter.title: monster hunter
LanguageData.LP_Bs_NetherilLooter.description: [PAWN_nameDef] dug through the ruins of the Netherese Empire in the Anauroch desert, searching for flying city fragments and lich manuscripts. [PAWN_nameDef] has one rule: never read aloud a scroll you don't understand.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_NetherilLooter.title: Netherese ruin robber
LanguageData.LP_Bs_EmberRunaway.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a slave at a fire giant's forge for ten years and escaped in the chaos of a volcanic eruption one night. To this day [PAWN_nameDef] instinctively ducks at the sound of a hammer.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_EmberRunaway.title: ember clan runaway slave
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RetiredAdventurer.description: In [PAWN_possessive] youth [PAWN_nameDef] slew dragons, rescued princesses and won a chest of gold, then spent it all on a tavern nobody visits. [PAWN_nameDef] tells the stories again and again, and every time the dragon is bigger than the last.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RetiredAdventurer.title: retired adventurer
